title: ApexBrasil e Sebrae levam 340 startups brasileiras para o Web Summit Lisboa (Startups.com.br, 3 November 2025)
what_it_says: Startups.com.br reports ApexBrasil and Sebrae taking 340 startups and innovative companies to Web Summit 2025 (256 selected by the two, 84 by partners), 226 selected the year before, and 123 first-timers.
